card.name: Just before a group or category noun
card.fires_on: Words where the next word is likely a group label such as group, class or category. These include taxonomic name parts (Whig, anurans, viverrine, tetrapods) and treatment-arm words (placebo, control) in trial results.

card.writes: It suppresses class, group and category words, so the model is less likely to write one of them next.
card.plain: It fires where a group or category is being named, and it holds back the word 'group' or 'class' coming next.
